initial_requirements: The Expanded Very Large Array needs an operations system for configuring and monitoring its radio-astronomy correlator and processing the resulting data stream in real time. Scientists and engineers should be able to inspect system health and observational data, while the software assembles and transforms correlator output into usable results for downstream storage and analysis. The system should identify faults and recover automatically where practical.

turns.interviewer_utterance: What are the primary operational goals and core capabilities this system must deliver for configuring the correlator, monitoring system health, and processing the data stream in real time?
turns.interviewee_utterance:
The main goal is to let operations staff set up the correlator for an observing run, verify that it is behaving correctly, and keep the data flowing without interruption. It also needs to take the raw correlator output, transform it into a usable form in real time, and hand it off for storage and later analysis.
On the monitoring side, people need a clear view of system health, current observing status, and the quality of the incoming data so they can spot issues quickly. Where possible, the system should detect faults on its own and recover automatically, since we can’t afford to lose data during an observation if we can avoid it.

slots.name: project_goals
slots.value: Enable operations staff to configure the correlator for an observing run, verify correct behavior, keep data flowing without interruption, transform raw correlator output into usable real-time results, and hand off data for storage and later analysis.

slots.name: stakeholder_roles
slots.value: Operations staff; scientists and engineers who monitor system health, observing status, and data quality.

slots.name: functional_needs
slots.value: Configure the correlator for observing runs; monitor system health, observing status, and incoming data quality; inspect operational behavior; transform raw correlator output into usable real-time data; pass processed data to storage and downstream analysis; detect faults and recover automatically where possible.

slots.name: business_rules
slots.value: The system should prioritize uninterrupted data flow during observations and attempt automatic fault recovery whenever practical to avoid data loss.

slots.name: data_entities
slots.value: Raw correlator output; processed/usable real-time data; system health information; observing status; data quality information.

slots.name: constraints
slots.value: Must support real-time processing and avoid data loss during observations where possible.

slots.name: quality_concerns
slots.value: High availability, uninterrupted data flow, rapid fault detection, automatic recovery, and clear visibility into system health and data quality.

slots.name: boundary_conditions
slots.value: Faults should be detected and recovered from automatically where practical; data loss should be avoided during observations if possible.
